answer: Sybil farms break when each new seat must occupy a unique desert cairn. The applicant is assigned one numbered marker on the public mesa terrace and, in a 12-minute window, drives a serialized copper rod to a recorded depth, then photographs it against a star-board centered on a catalogued nebula that clocks the slot. Filing costs 0.30 POA plus a 19 POA bond held 13 epochs. Auditors re-measure rod depth and serial, match the marker to the terrace plat, and check the timestamp. A reused marker, a swapped rod, or a field more than three arcminutes off seizes the bond and voids both claims.
